title: Scaffold an Ionic/Cordova application
description: Generates an Ionic/Cordova Angular application with the Nx targets for web, native and live-reload builds.

name.description: The Nx project name of the new application. It is a name, not a path: it must start with a letter and contain no '/', '\', ':' or whitespace. Use --directory for the location.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the application?

appId.description: The reverse-DNS application id (widget id), e.g. com.acme.shop. It has no default because a wrong id is a store-identity defect.
appId.x-prompt: What is the application id (reverse-DNS, e.g. com.acme.shop)?

directory.description: The directory the application is generated under. It must be a relative path inside the workspace, without '..' segments.

displayName.description: The application name shown on-device. Defaults to the project name.

prefix.description: The Angular component and directive selector prefix.
